lead: An example's `#[Test]` method never runs in the proof sweep.
body: Examples run with `nvs run <file>`, so only the top level is checked and a broken `#[Test(server: true)]` or `#[Test(at: …)]` method stays green. Run the file by hand with `target/debug/nvs.exe test --config <dir>/nvs.toml <file>` before committing it, and give the top level a line that prints under `nvs run`.
